claims.assertion: Yazhi says Taygeta served as the Federation's military force under Asket, until Alenym withdrew most of its fleet in 2018–19.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She says one ship remained as a political representative.

claims.assertion: Yazhi says Federation propaganda prepared Taygetan fleet cadets to believe they would liberate oppressed planets.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She suggests this propaganda could reflect ignorance rather than deliberate deception.

claims.assertion: Swaruu X (Athena) says previous Taygetan crews accepted Federation propaganda, while the current crew began questioning it.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She describes this as a spiritual awakening also occurring among nonhuman peoples.
